next_step_summary: PR #247 extends the populated provider-independent Question Engine inventory with the recurring pre-signing financial-sanctions and overlap mechanism. The bounded slice keeps late-payment additions, holdover compensation, fixed agreed damages, other explicit contractual monetary sanctions, and overlap as separate contract-fact questions; it preserves trigger, amount/formula, timing, stated loss head, and interaction language without encoding court-outcome or reduction rules. It adds no conditional trigger runtime, evidence-target layer, statutory/case-law runtime, severity thresholds, post-dispute mode, LLM/provider integration, UI, OCR, Android, serverless, storage, dependencies, permissions, workflows, or network access. The next bounded inventory slice is condition / AS-IS / defects / damage evidence.
